description: We are a passionate and collaborative team of CSE students interested in technology, space, AI, and innovative problem-solving. We enjoy learning new skills and building creative projects together. We are looking for motivated team members with skills in programming, UI/UX design, research, presentation, and teamwork to make our project successful.
summary:
Field Shift is an intelligent, data-driven agricultural platform designed to help farmers make smarter and more sustainable farming decisions in response to climate change. It integrates NASA Earth observation technologies, including SMAP, GPM, MODIS, ECOSTRESS, and NASA POWER, with local soil conditions, crop characteristics, and farmers’ priorities.

The platform analyzes soil moisture, rainfall, temperature, vegetation health, and climate risks to recommend suitable crops, suggest effective crop rotation strategies, and provide irrigation guidance. It transforms complex satellite data into simple, practical insights, helping farmers reduce uncertainty and improve agricultural productivity.

Field Shift addresses major challenges such as irregular rainfall, rising temperatures, drought, and water scarcity. By connecting NASA technology with real-world farming needs, it promotes sustainable agriculture, optimizes natural resources, reduces climate-related farming risks, strengthens food security, and supports the development of climate-resilient farming communities.
details: Field Shift is a data-driven agricultural platform designed to help farmers adapt to climate change and environmental uncertainty. It integrates NASA Earth observation data from SMAP, GPM, MODIS, ECOSTRESS, and NASA POWER with local soil conditions, crop characteristics, and farmer priorities. The platform analyzes soil moisture, rainfall, temperature, vegetation health, and climate risks to provide suitable crop recommendations, crop rotation plans, irrigation guidance, and climate insights. Built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and NASA APIs, it transforms complex satellite data into simple, practical information through data visualization. Its innovative approach connects space-based technology with real-world agricultural needs, helping farmers make informed decisions, reduce climate-related risks, conserve water, and improve productivity. By considering seasonal changes, soil conditions, water availability, and local farming requirements, Field Shift aims to promote sustainable agriculture, strengthen food security, and build climate-resilient farming communities.
